notes.title: Update(2024-11-4)
notes.content:
1. Dual-screen support is now available, allowing you to play on one screen while doing other tasks on the other.
2. The Unity splash screen has been removed.
3. Some minor optimizations have been made to the buttons.
4. The music playback logic has been optimized.

notes.title: Update(020305)
notes.content:
I made some changes recently:

1. Spring background color.
2. Density of branches and leaves.
3, The color of flowers.
4. Spring background color.
5. Added two ancient songs.
6. Changed the shape of the fruit.
7, The shape of the pots.
8. Adjust the growth rate.
9. For the lag problem, the growth control process was modified.
10. The shape of the tree has been modified.

notes.title: Update (190425):
notes.content:
Thank you for your love and support! The game has recently been a little upgraded:
1, The English version of the tutorial page.
2, The probability of mushroom emergence has doubled.
3. The camera operation adjusts the initial height and the rotation speed.
4, The details of the spring flowers are adjusted.

notes.title: Update(190321)
notes.content:
1, the zodiac icon display mode.
2, camera control is smoother.
3, rain and snow effects.
4, the direction of the sun.
5, the initial interface adapts to different resolutions.

notes.title: Update (181015)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
I made some adjustments based on feedback:

1, Unlock the zodiac achievement.
2, Speed up the growth rate.
3, Tips for the devil fruit.
4, Hotkey: spacebar to re-center and grow.

notes.title: Update (180919)
notes.content:
Hello, everyone,

Here are the minor adjustments and upgrades I made:

1. Revised the shape of pine, wisteria, and jasmine.
2. When adding nutrients to the branches, the branches will become thicker and the effect will be more obvious.
3. Adjust the color of the initial basin.
4. Optimized the density of the flowers.
5. The color of the leaves has been slightly adjusted.

notes.title: Update (180906)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[b]The game's achievements have not been finished.[/b]

[b]Updates are as follows:[/b]
1, The first year to accelerate the growth rate.
2, Automatic nutrient solution replenishment.
3, The flowers opening process adjustment.
4, The leaves are more dense.
5, Some interface adjustments.

Thank you very much!
